execute_file_write.description: Write UTF-8 text to a file in the calling tenant's workspace, creating parent directories as needed. Paths are namespaced per tenant. Mutating: suspends until a second operator approves.

read_file.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the calling tenant's workspace. Paths are relative to that tenant's workspace root; traversal outside it is rejected, so one tenant cannot read another's files. Read-only.

read_system_status.description: Read-only host and runtime status: platform, Python version, UTC time, workspace root and process id. Safe to call without approval.
